issue.title: Dead phase worker after failed finalizing leaves in_progress bead ownerless with no relaunch
issue.description: Phase worker retry sase-1r2.6--2 produced verified 109-golden Full CI repair as local commit 48d0c3ea, staged monitor 3w69pb, then its turn ended failed at host commit finalizing on 2026-11-07 (unpublished_local_commits, see finalizer_result.json in artifacts/ace-run/202611/07/20261107104958/). Bead sase-1r2.6 stayed in_progress with dead owner for 5 days; no healer, auto-restart, or epic watchdog relaunched it (watchdog only covers reboot stranding), land agent sase-1r2.land stayed parked, and recovery only happened via sase-1rq.2.1.5.1.4 takeover as dd5567e580 plus human-prompted unstall on 2026-11-12. Distinct from sase-1qj (reboot strand) and sase-1se (update-skew healer): this is a failed-finalizer ownerless phase with no reboot and no update skew.

task_type_fields.impact: Epic silently stalls for days with land agent parked on a dead phase; only manual takeover plus human-prompted recovery unsticks it.
task_type_fields.location: sase bead work dead-runner recovery + src/sase/agent/auto_restart/healer_relaunch.py + epic reboot watchdog (reboot-only)
task_type_fields.repro: Phase agent sase-1r2.6--2 turn ends failed in finalizing with unpublished_local_commits; observe bead sase-1r2.6 stays in_progress with dead assignee, sase agent list shows no live owner, and no healer/auto-restart/watchdog relaunch fires over 5 days (2026-11-07 to 2026-11-12); epic sase-1r2 stalls until manual takeover.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1r2 stalled silently for 5 days because failed phase worker sase-1r2.6--2 was never relaunched; captures the gap the recovery plan exposed.
